global_style.art_style: Consistent minimalist hand-drawn stickman animation illustrations for an engaging, thought-provoking YouTube finance short. Warm off-white paper background, bold slightly imperfect black ink outlines, round white stickman faces with expressive eyes, thin black limbs, and a small red bow tie on the recurring presenter. Use gold yellow for gold, muted grey for paper currency, copper orange for copper coins, and silver grey for silver coins. Simple visual metaphors, funny reactions, dramatic visual contrasts, clean compositions, and strong storytelling. Vertical 9:16 framing. Every image should look like a frame from the same hand-drawn explainer animation.
global_style.negative_prompt: Photorealism, 3D rendering, realistic human anatomy, detailed skin, complex backgrounds, excessive colors, gradients, clutter, tiny unreadable text, watermarks, logos, inconsistent stickman designs, extra limbs, distorted faces, illegible lettering.

main_presenter.label: Finance Stickman Presenter
main_presenter.visual_dna: A minimalist hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive black eyes, a flexible curved mouth, thin black arms and legs, and a small red bow tie. Friendly, curious, and expressive. Maintain the same appearance in every frame.

gold_coins.label: Gold Currency
gold_coins.visual_dna: Small shiny-looking but flat hand-drawn yellow-gold coins with bold black outlines and a simple embossed circular symbol.

paper_money.label: Paper Currency
paper_money.visual_dna: Simple rectangular grey-green paper banknotes with abstract symbols, bold black outlines, and no real country-specific currency design.

beats.narration_text: एक सेकंड सोचो... अगर कल सुबह उठते ही दुनिया का सारा पैसा गायब हो जाए?
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive black eyes, thin black limbs, and a red bow tie wakes up in surprise. The presenter looks at an empty wallet, with scattered question marks floating around the head. Minimal off-white paper background, bold black ink outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Make the presenter's expression shocked and curious.

beats.narration_text: न डॉलर, न रुपये, न ऑनलाइन पेमेंट... सिर्फ सोने के सिक्के!
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, thin black limbs, and a red bow tie stands between a pile of crossed-out paper banknotes and a huge pile of yellow-gold coins. The presenter stares at the gold coins in disbelief. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, grey and gold accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Make the contrast between paper money and gold coins immediately obvious.

beats.narration_text: और दुनिया वापस पुराने जमाने की तरह सोने, चाँदी और ताँबे से व्यापार करने लगे?
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman marketplace in an old-fashioned setting. A merchant stickman exchanges yellow-gold coins, silver-grey coins, and copper-orange coins for food, fabric, and tools. A second stickman watches the exchange with curiosity. Bold black ink outlines, off-white paper background, limited historical accent colors, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show a lively old-fashioned market where metal coins are the main method of payment.

beats.narration_text: सबसे पहले, तुम्हारी जेब में पड़े दस रुपये के सिक्के की जगह एक छोटा सोने का टुकड़ा होगा।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, thin black limbs, and a red bow tie holds a tiny yellow-gold coin between two fingers, examining it closely. The coin is drawn as a simple valuable metal disc with bold black outlines. Minimal off-white paper background, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Make the tiny gold coin look precious and important.

beats.narration_text: चाय पीनी है? सोना दो। किराना खरीदना है? सोना दो।
beats.prompt_action: Two hand-drawn mini marketplace scenes stacked vertically. In the first, a stickman customer gives a tiny gold coin to a tea seller and receives a steaming cup. In the second, another customer gives a gold coin to a grocery shopkeeper and receives a small grocery bag. Round white faces, thin black limbs, bold black outlines, off-white paper background, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Make both everyday transactions easy to understand at a glance.

beats.narration_text: सुनने में तो बड़ा शानदार लगता है, है ना?
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs, and a red bow tie smiles while holding a small pile of gold coins. A sparkling gold star appears above the coins. Minimal off-white paper background, bold black ink outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The presenter looks playfully impressed and raises an eyebrow toward the viewer.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन असली कहानी अब शुरू होती है।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman presenter with a round white face, thin black limbs, and a red bow tie suddenly looks serious. Behind the presenter, a giant gold coin casts a dramatic shadow across the off-white paper background. Bold black ink outlines, vertical 9:16 framing.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Shift the mood from excitement to suspense.

beats.narration_text: पहली समस्या: हर चीज़ का छोटा-सा भुगतान करना मुश्किल हो जाएगा।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman customer with a round white face and thin black limbs struggles to break a large gold coin into tiny pieces to pay for a small cup of tea. A confused tea seller watches. Bold black outlines, gold accents, off-white paper background, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the customer looking frustrated because the coin is too valuable for a tiny purchase.

beats.narration_text: मान लो चाय की कीमत सिर्फ एक छोटा-सा सोने का कण है।
beats.prompt_action: An extreme close-up hand-drawn illustration of a tiny gold particle resting on a fingertip beside a small tea cup. The gold particle is extremely small and difficult to handle. Bold black ink outlines, minimal gold accents, clean off-white paper background, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Make the tiny gold particle visibly difficult to pick up.

beats.narration_text: अब हर दुकान पर सोना तौलने वाली मशीन चाहिए होगी!
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn shopkeeper stickman with a round white face, thin black limbs, and a simple apron carefully weighs a tiny gold piece on a small precision scale. A customer stickman waits impatiently in a queue. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, yellow-gold accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the absurd inconvenience of weighing gold for an everyday purchase.

beats.narration_text: और अगर दुकानदार के पास छुट्टे सोने के सिक्के ही न हों तो?
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn shopkeeper stickman with a round white face and thin black limbs turns both empty pockets inside out. A customer stickman stands waiting with a gold coin in hand, looking annoyed. Minimal off-white paper background, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Give both characters exaggerated, funny expressions of frustration.

beats.narration_text: दूसरी समस्या: सोना हर जगह बराबर मात्रा में नहीं मिलेगा।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn world map on an off-white paper background. One region contains a large pile of gold nuggets while another region has almost none. Two stickman traders stand on opposite sides, looking concerned. Bold black ink outlines, gold and muted blue accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Make the uneven distribution of gold visually clear.

beats.narration_text: जिस देश के पास ज्यादा सोना होगा, उसके पास ज्यादा खरीदने की ताकत हो सकती है।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman leader with a round white face and thin black limbs stands beside an enormous mountain of gold coins, while a second leader stands beside a nearly empty coin basket. Both look toward each other across a simple map. Bold black outlines, gold and grey accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the difference in gold reserves between the two regions.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन जिन देशों के पास सोना कम है, उनके लिए व्यापार करना मुश्किल हो सकता है।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman trader from a region with very few gold coins approaches a market stall full of goods. The merchant refuses the trade because the trader has too little gold. The trader looks disappointed. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Focus on the difficulty of trading when a country or trader has limited gold.

beats.narration_text: और सोने की नई खदान मिलते ही उसकी कीमत और पूरी अर्थव्यवस्था हिल सकती है।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn mining scene where stickman miners discover a huge gold vein inside a mountain. Outside, two traders watch a balance scale holding gold coins on one side and everyday goods on the other, as the scale begins to tilt. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, gold accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show a sudden gold discovery creating uncertainty in the value of gold.

beats.narration_text: तीसरी समस्या: आज की दुनिया में व्यापार सिर्फ दुकानों तक सीमित नहीं है।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman presenter with a round white face, thin black limbs, and a red bow tie stands in front of a huge globe surrounded by cargo ships, airplanes, factories, and delivery trucks. Off-white paper background, bold black ink outlines, blue and gold accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Make the modern global economy look enormous and interconnected.

beats.narration_text: एक देश दूसरे देश से तेल खरीदता है, कंपनियाँ लाखों ऑनलाइन पेमेंट करती हैं।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn split-screen illustration. On one side, a cargo ship carries oil barrels between two countries. On the other side, a business stickman sits at a computer sending a large digital payment represented by a glowing simple payment symbol. Bold black outlines, off-white paper background, muted blue and gold accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Contrast physical international trade with fast digital payments.

beats.narration_text: अब हर पेमेंट के लिए असली सोना एक जगह से दूसरी जगह भेजना पड़े, तो सोचो कितना समय लगेगा!
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn cargo plane and a large armored delivery truck transport heavy gold bars across a globe. Several stickman businesspeople wait impatiently beside clocks and delayed shipment symbols. Off-white paper background, bold black ink outlines, gold and blue accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Emphasize the slowness and logistical burden of physically moving gold.

beats.narration_text: इसीलिए शायद सोने के डिजिटल सर्टिफिकेट या टोकन इस्तेमाल होने लगें।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, thin black limbs, and a red bow tie looks at a smartphone displaying a simple digital gold token icon. Behind the phone, a locked vault contains neatly stacked gold bars. A thin dotted line connects the digital token to the physical gold vault. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the idea of digital claims backed by gold, not a magical disappearance of the physical asset.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन रुक जाओ... क्या सोना इस्तेमाल करने से महँगाई खत्म हो जाएगी?
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman presenter with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs, and a red bow tie points toward a large question mark. Behind the presenter, a small shopping basket contains food items with rising price tags. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The presenter looks curious and challenges the viewer to think.

beats.narration_text: जरूरी नहीं! अगर सोने की सप्लाई सीमित हो और अर्थव्यवस्था तेजी से बढ़े,
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn illustration of a growing city with more houses, factories, shops, and people, while a small locked vault contains only a limited number of gold bars. A simple balance scale between the city and the vault tilts unevenly. Off-white paper background, bold black ink outlines, gold and blue accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show economic activity growing faster than the available gold supply.

beats.narration_text: तो सामान की कीमतें गिर सकती हैं, और कर्ज चुकाना ज्यादा मुश्किल हो सकता है।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman shopkeeper lowers price tags on shelves while a second stickman borrower struggles to carry a huge debt ledger. A small pile of gold coins sits beside the ledger. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, muted green and gold accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Visually connect falling prices with the burden of repaying fixed debts.

beats.narration_text: और आर्थिक संकट आने पर सरकारों के पास तुरंत कदम उठाने की आजादी भी कम हो सकती है।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn government building with a stickman leader standing outside, looking worried at a locked gold vault. Nearby, a factory is slowing down and workers wait anxiously. A simple emergency lever is visible but blocked by a chain attached to the vault. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Use the locked vault as a metaphor for limited policy flexibility.

beats.narration_text: तो क्या सोना बेकार है? बिल्कुल नहीं।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman presenter with a round white face, expressive black eyes, thin black limbs, and a red bow tie holds a beautiful gold coin carefully in one hand. The presenter shakes the other hand to reject an exaggerated crossed-out symbol. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, gold accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Make the presenter look confident and balanced, not dismissive of gold.

beats.narration_text: सोना आज भी कई लोगों के लिए बचत और भरोसे का एक अहम साधन है।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn family stickman with round white faces and thin black limbs carefully places a few gold coins into a small secure savings box. Their expressions are calm and thoughtful. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, warm gold accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show gold as a store of value and a form of savings.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन पूरी दुनिया को सिर्फ सोने पर चलाना... शायद इतना आसान नहीं होगा।
beats.prompt_action: A giant hand-drawn gold coin sits beneath a globe representing the world economy. The globe is connected to factories, shops, cargo ships, banks, and homes by many thin lines. The gold coin looks too small to support all the activity alone. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, gold and muted blue accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Create a thought-provoking image showing the complexity of a gold-only global economy.

beats.narration_text: अब बताओ, अगर कल से दुनिया में सिर्फ सोना ही पैसा बन जाए, तो तुम इसके पक्ष में हो या खिलाफ?
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman presenter with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs, and a red bow tie points directly toward the viewer. Two large speech bubbles appear on either side: one contains a smiling gold coin, the other contains a worried face beside a gold coin. A simple comment icon sits below. Off-white paper background, bold black ink outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: End with a playful debate invitation and direct eye contact with the viewer.
